stem: ![](asset:P000448-stem-1)A small block of mass m is kept on a rough wedge of inclination θ with the horizontal. The incline is fixed inside an elevator. The elevator goes up with a uniform velocity of v and the block does not slide. The work done by (i) the frictional force and (ii) the normal reaction on the block in time t is

answer.text: (i) mg sin²θ vt (ii) mg cos²θ vt

assets.alt: A lift moving up with velocity v, containing a fixed incline of angle θ with a block of mass m on it.
